verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise tier advertises "programmatic queries via API" and "batch processing for high-volume research work." GSK's internal AI platform connects to it programmatically. Its remote HTTP MCP server can also be attached to CLI agents such as Claude Code, the Codex CLI and the Copilot CLI. This points to non-interactive, automated use, but nothing documents headless or CI operation itself, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: public API reference/OpenAPI spec, documented headless/CI workflow or non-interactive auth (API keys/service accounts), API availability outside the enterprise tier, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
